title: Meatballs with Calabrian Chili Tomato Sauce
headnote: Isabelle Heikens' meatballs with bacon and spicy tomato sauce, originally published in At Isabelle's (Sep 27, 2026). Makes about 20 large meatballs. Favorable remarks in the newsletter were the author's, not a confirmed user cooking test.

ingredientGroups.title: Meatballs
items: 75 g finely grated Parmesan (original: ¾ cup; approximate)
10 g Diamond Crystal kosher salt (original: 2 tsp; approximate)

ingredientGroups.title: Calabrian chili tomato sauce
items: 15 g Calabrian chili paste (original: 1 tbsp; approximate)
1,590 g canned whole tomatoes (original: two 28-oz cans), crushed by hand

steps: Pulse the cold bacon until finely minced, stopping short of a paste. Combine it with the beef.
Finely process the onion, garlic, and parsley and add to the meat.
Soak the panko in the milk; mix with Parmesan, thyme, pepper, and eggs. Season meat with salt, then gently combine with the soaked breadcrumb mixture without overworking.
Shape into about 20 large meatballs. Sear in batches in a lightly oiled Dutch oven until browned on all sides, then transfer to a plate.
For the sauce, soften diced onion in the pan, then add sliced garlic. Stir in tomato and Calabrian chili pastes and cook until darkened and fragrant.

Add crushed tomatoes and some water, scraping the pan. Bring to a simmer, nestle in the seared meatballs, cover and cook gently for 30–45 minutes until cooked through (160°F at center for ground beef).
Cook pasta if using, toss with tomato sauce and a little butter, and serve with meatballs.
